# Crest Studio by Usurp

> Free online coat of arms and family crest maker. Anyone can design a heraldic crest (name, motto, colors, division, emblem) in the browser for free with no account. A one-time $9 purchase downloads print-ready files (4000 px PNG, 1200 px PNG, SVG vector), a certificate of arms with its blazon and meaning, a profile picture and a phone wallpaper. A $29 Crest Logo Kit adds transparent logo files, favicons and app icons, social banners and a brand sheet for clubs, teams and businesses. All files are usable for any lawful purpose, personal or commercial. Original decorative artwork, not an official grant of arms. Payments by Dodo Payments; 14-day refunds.

## Main tool
- [Crest Studio home](https://usurp.games/): what Crest Studio is, sample files, and six crests for any last name
- [Crest Studio: design your own coat of arms](https://usurp.games/crest.html): the free designer with 50 heraldic emblems, and the $9 download

## Free tools and guides
- [Family Crest Generator by Last Name](https://usurp.games/family-crest-generator.html): Type your last name and get six original family crest designs in one click, each with its heraldic blazon. Free to customize; $9 for print-ready files and a certificate.
- [What Would Your Coat of Arms Be?](https://usurp.games/coat-of-arms-quiz.html): Take the free 2-minute heraldry quiz and get your own coat of arms: colors, emblem and Latin motto chosen from your answers, with its meaning. Share it with friends.
- [Coat of Arms Ideas](https://usurp.games/coat-of-arms-ideas.html): Browse 74 original coat of arms and family crest ideas for families, fantasy houses, sports clubs, businesses, weddings, school houses and gaming clans. Customize any of them free.
- [Family Crest Maker](https://usurp.games/family-crest-maker.html): Design your own family crest online in a minute. Choose colors, an emblem and a family motto with meaning. Free to design, $9 for print-ready PNG and SVG files.
- [D&D Coat of Arms Generator](https://usurp.games/dnd-coat-of-arms-generator.html): Make a coat of arms for your D&D noble house, guild, knightly order or character. Free online heraldry maker with transparent PNG for maps and tokens.
- [Wedding Crest Maker](https://usurp.games/wedding-crest.html): Design a wedding crest for your invitations, signage and wax seals. Join two family names on one shield. Free to design, $9 for print-ready SVG and PNG files.
- [Clan and Guild Logo Maker](https://usurp.games/clan-logo-maker.html): Make a heraldic clan logo or guild emblem for your gaming group, Discord server or esports team. Free online maker, $9 for transparent PNG and SVG.
- [School House Crests](https://usurp.games/school-house-crests.html): Create a crest for each house in your school or classroom house system, with Latin mottos and colors. Free to design; print-ready files for posters and certificates.
